about: A one-handed builder's hammer: a small iron head on a short haft. The tool that builds (items.ron's Hammer); a war hammer or mace is another kind.

hold_class.source: tools/characters/attach_kinds.json (hafted's classes; holding.md: tools keep their own class)

hands.source: holding.md section 1: a tool goes in the main hand; one in the off hand is refused by the rule

lead.source: D463: the main hand, the left on a left-handed body (holding.md Mirroring)

grip_type.source: D562: in hand, a power grip closed by touch on the haft

slots.name: head
slots.joins: its eye's two openings on the haft's line; the haft made to their diameters, 4 mm proud of eye.upper

slots.name: haft
slots.joins: a round shaft along +Y from its butt

slots.name: binding
slots.joins: its bore on the haft: under the head (its straps, as today's look has 43 cm of them) or at the grip (a leather wrap)

grip.how: on the haft, grip_from_end up from its butt (the reference's 0.06 m; D546's hafted 0.04 to 0.12): the item's origin

second.how: held in one hand; a great hammer is another kind (holding.md's great_hammer)

edge.how: the head's face point (its striking face's centre and span along +Y, on -Z, D546) carried through; a claw on +Z is not a working edge

held.how: a tool has no ready pose: the Tool stance holds no guard (holding.md), so in hand it is carried until used

used.how: the player's build plays the walker's Interact (terra_walker::figure); townsfolk building and smithing play Hammer_Loop (assets/data/life.ron)

open.why: the player's hammering clip: Interact is a reach, not a blow; Hammer_Loop is not keyed for the reference's head, so the face's lead is unchecked

carried.how: tipped by the carry rule, its head forward and down (attachment.md Carried)

stowed.how: a one-handed hafted item at the hip on the main hand's side, mirrored for a left-handed body

open.why: the turn and offset on the socket are not set (attachment.md Stowed's next step)

blocking.how: a tool does not block: the Tool stance's off button is the build menu (holding.md, Which button does what)

animation.how: none yet of its own: the Tool stance plays the walker's use clips (holding.md: the tool's use moves)

open.why: a hammer's use set (holding.md's count, the tools' three), keyed for the reference

length_m.source: art/held/hammer.json length; the look's bounds measured 0.420

mass_kg.source: the head and a 0.025 m ash haft 0.42 m long (670 kg/m^3, recalled), 0.14 kg; a stand-in until its parts are weighed

balance_m.source: computed from the head at 0.385 m and the haft's middle, from the grip

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's I = m (b^2 + L^2/12) on the numbers above

grip_diameter_m.source: the hammer look's handle across, median (research/2026-10-28-assembled-parts-art.md section 4)

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's tempo clamp 0.85 to 1.15: I_ref/1.15^2 to I_ref/0.85^2

length_m.source: the reference's length ±10% at a fixed head (research/2026-10-28-assembled-items-animation.md section 1)

head_mass_kg.source: the inertia band at the reference's length, solved for the head (-26% to +40%)

balance_m.source: the inertia band at the reference's mass and length, solved for the balance

envelope.state: computed from stand-in masses; the hammer's use clips are not keyed for any item, so nothing is measured
